title: ESP Ra.De. - A.D.2018 Tokyo
note: Shoot'em up by Cave (CAVE): credits, lives, lives_p2, bombs, bombs_p2, power, power_p2, multiplier (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Cave 68000 work RAM from 0x100000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

lives.note: lives (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL1)

lives_p2.note: lives of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL2)

bombs.note: bombs of player 1 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL1)

bombs_p2.note: bombs of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL2)

power.note: shot level of player 1, 4 at most (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Power PL1)

power_p2.note: shot level of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Power PL2)

multiplier.note: combo bonus multiplier, x16 at most: the value read plus one (FBNeo cheat database, Always Combo Bonus x16)

stage.note: stage, the value read plus one, Inside Yaksa counted with stage 5 (RetroAchievements rich presence StageVariant and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score.note: player 1 score, BCD, its last digit always 0 (RetroAchievements leaderboards, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, learn it with learn.bat in a two-player game (score2=...)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)
